role: CI gate: compares every integer value in .ci/*.txt against a baseline git ref and fails when a ceiling rises or a min_* floor falls without a `budget-raise-ok:` commit trailer.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd (relies on being run from repo root). BASE_REF=$1; CI_DIR env default .ci; no CI dir -> exit 0; not a git repo -> exit 0. Baseline resolution: $1, else origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF, else $BUDGET_BASE_REF, else no_baseline. Null SHA or unresolvable ref -> no_baseline. allowed_changes = paths after `budget-raise-ok:` trailers in `git log BASE..HEAD`. Loop over `find .ci -maxdepth 1 -name '*.txt'`: skip non-integer current values, files absent at baseline, non-integer baseline values; equal -> continue; loosened = (min_* file ? current<previous : current>previous); loosened & allowed -> 'ALLOWED', loosened & not allowed -> violation, else 'ratcheted'. Any violation -> exit 1, else 'clean. N budgets compared'. Wired: gates.yml push (BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE=1 against HEAD~1), ci.yml, Makefile budget-monotonicity (baseline HEAD).

flags.text: Non-integer budget files are skipped (`read_int ... || continue`). .ci/min_coverage_views.txt holds 43.5, so the views coverage floor can be lowered to any value without a violation; running the gate reports '26 budgets compared' for 28 files.

Only files present in the current tree are compared, so deleting a budget/floor file is never seen as loosening. check_coverage.sh then silently falls back to built-in floors 16/30/0 when min_coverage*.txt is missing.

On push, gates.yml compares only against HEAD~1. When one push carries several commits, a budget raised in any commit before the last is already in the baseline and is never compared, so the raise passes without a budget-raise-ok trailer.

Header says values are compared 'against the merge base'; for PRs the baseline is `origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF` (the target branch tip), so a budget lowered on main after the branch point reports as a raise on the PR. Header also lists three min_* floors; there are five (min_coverage_views, min_science_register_entries also exist).

units.does: No usable baseline: if BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE is non-empty prints the reason to stderr and exits 1; otherwise prints a skip message and exits 0.
Returns failure if no trailers were collected; otherwise succeeds when the file path exactly equals a path named in a `budget-raise-ok:` trailer (grep -Fxq).
Succeeds when the file's basename starts with min_ (a floor that may only rise).
Strips whitespace from the raw text; returns failure unless it is all digits; prints the integer.

flags.text: Decimal floors are treated as absent: .ci/min_coverage_views.txt (43.5) fails the regex and the caller `continue`s, so that floor is never ratchet-checked.
